source: A memory leak can cause the application to crash. The thread pool limits the number of concurrent tasks. Garbage collection frees unused memory automatically.
reference: 内存泄漏可能导致应用程序崩溃。线程池限制并发任务的数量。垃圾回收会自动释放不再使用的内存。

source: A race condition occurs when two threads access shared data. The system deadlocked because two processes waited for each other. The stack overflow was caused by infinite recursion.
reference: 当两个线程访问共享数据时会发生竞态条件。由于两个进程互相等待，系统发生了死锁。栈溢出是由无限递归引起的。

source: Always check for buffer overflow when handling user input. The null pointer dereference crashed the program. Use-after-free bugs are difficult to reproduce.
reference: 处理用户输入时始终要检查缓冲区溢出。空指针解引用导致程序崩溃。释放后使用错误很难复现。

source: The source code is available on GitHub. This project is open source and free to use. Please submit a pull request with your changes.
reference: 源代码可以在 GitHub 上找到。这个项目是开源的，可以免费使用。请提交一个包含你修改的拉取请求。

source: Every pull request requires a code review. We added a unit test for the parser. The integration test covers the entire pipeline.
reference: 每个拉取请求都需要代码审查。我们为解析器添加了一个单元测试。集成测试覆盖了整个流水线。

source: The regression test caught the bug before release. Run the command from the command line. The operating system manages hardware resources.
reference: 回归测试在发布前发现了这个错误。从命令行运行该命令。操作系统管理硬件资源。

source: The file system stores metadata separately. The database query returned no results. Machine learning models require large amounts of data.
reference: 文件系统单独存储元数据。数据库查询没有返回结果。机器学习模型需要大量数据。

source: Deep learning has improved image recognition. The neural network has six layers. Artificial intelligence is changing the software industry.
reference: 深度学习改进了图像识别。这个神经网络有六层。人工智能正在改变软件行业。

source: A large language model can generate text. Natural language processing helps computers understand text. Cloud computing reduces the need for local servers.
reference: 大语言模型可以生成文本。自然语言处理帮助计算机理解文本。云计算减少了对本地服务器的需求。

source: The distributed system must tolerate node failures. The load balancer distributes requests across servers. Each microservice has its own database.
reference: 分布式系统必须容忍节点故障。负载均衡器把请求分发到多台服务器。每个微服务都有自己的数据库。

source: The virtual machine runs a separate operating system. The compiler translates source code into machine code. The interpreter executes the program line by line.
reference: 虚拟机运行一个独立的操作系统。编译器把源代码翻译成机器码。解释器逐行执行程序。

source: The runtime provides memory management and error handling. Garbage collection pauses can affect latency. The cache reduced the average response time.
reference: 运行时提供内存管理和错误处理。垃圾回收停顿会影响延迟。缓存降低了平均响应时间。

source: We measured throughput and latency under load. The network bandwidth is the bottleneck. The API returns JSON responses.

source: The SDK includes a command-line interface. The CPU usage stayed below 50%. The GPU accelerates matrix multiplication.
